assessment_summary: I validated the UrbanKIT Plattform Docker Compose installation in /workspace against the supplied Installation.md. Procedure: (1) Confirmed repo layout and the four compose services (web=Next.js 15.4.11, hocuspocus sidecar, mongo:7, mailpit dev mailcatcher), .env created from .env.example with required PAYLOAD_SECRET/HOCUSPOCUS_SECRET set, and the extra local override file docker-compose.noresources.yml (untracked in git; strips only deploy.resources.limits via !reset null). (2) Verified the stack is running exactly on the guide's published loopback ports (3020, 1234, 27019, 1025/8025) with web/mongo/mailpit reporting healthy. (3) Ran the guide's own acceptance check: curl http://localhost:3020/api/health → 200 {\"ok\":true}. (4) Exercised the middleware domain routing with Host headers: urbankit.de → 307 to /de and portal homepage renders (correct German title/content); app.urbankit.de → /de/login with a working login form; bare localhost → 307. (5) Proved the realtime sidecar is genuinely the Hocuspocus server, not a dummy port: logs show v2.15.3 Ready, HTTP / returns 200 OK, and a raw WebSocket handshake got 101 Switching Protocols with a cryptographically correct Sec-WebSocket-Accept for the test key, followed by an 'Unauthorized' app-level message for the unauthenticated connection. (6) Inspected Mongo: urban_kit database auto-created with all 32 expected Payload collections on first boot, confirming the web service successfully connected and initialized its schema; collections are empty because user/project seeding (seed:prototype/seed:demo) is documented as an optional one-off action, not part of the base install. (7) Verified the build: /app/.next production build present, media/uploads volume mount points exist in the container, and the build-time NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL arg is baked in (rendered pages reference http://localhost:3020; the http://localhost:3000 fallback appears nowhere). (8) Investigated the installer's reported environment obstacle and reproduced it: any container created with a cgroup memory limit fails with the exact 'cgroupv2 … threaded mode' runc error, while limit-less containers succeed — confirming the noresources override was necessary in this sandbox and that it changes nothing about the software's own configuration. Not completed (by design, all explicitly production/VPS-only or optional in the guide): docker-compose.prod.yml hardening (Mongo root auth, unpublished Mongo port, restart: always), demo-account seeding, an actual authenticated browser login (no users seeded), and external nginx/TLS for the urbankit.de domains. No check failed; the small number of empty-data observations are consistent with a correctly installed but unseeded prototype. Outcome: success.
